range.title: Trend over time
range.hint: Trend lines summarize sampled research over each {days}-day window. Compare skills, roles or categories.
range.empty: No daily history is stored yet. It appears after the next scheduled data run.
range.emptyRange: Nothing moved in this range. Choose other dates or lines.
range.emptyShort: A trend point needs {days} stored days of papers. History is still being collected.
range.table: Show every point as a table
range.note: Observed in a sample of up to 50 newest arXiv cs.AI papers per day; research attention, not job demand. Gaps mean a 7-day window is not fully stored and are never filled in.
range.limit: Up to {max} lines. Untick one to add another.
range.rejected: That choice could not be shown (dates outside stored data, a start after the end, a range over {days} days, an unknown line, or more than {max} lines). Showing the biggest movers instead.
